text:
elaine: @channel Shipping the OpenBench Adapters Interop Kit v1.0.0-interop 🎉

elaine: Hi all — we've just released a small repo with sample adapters and glue code to connect OpenBench test suites to Redwood's model runtime. Goal: make it easy for community projects and partner labs to run cross-runtime benchmarks with minimal boilerplate.

elaine: Highlights:
- adapter templates for HF, ONNX, and Triton
- interoperability tests and a pytest harness
- CI configs + perf sanity checks
- a short demo notebook (notebook link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/openbench-adapters/tree/main/notebooks/demo.ipynb)

ben: Nice! Is there a migration path for existing contrib adapters built for older harnesses?

elaine: yes — there's a migration script in /scripts/migrate_v0_to_v1.sh and a compatibility note in README. Sample command:
```
./scripts/migrate_v0_to_v1.sh --src ./old-adapter --out ./adapter-v1
```

marcos: Will this be included in our community benchmark runner? Any perf regressions to watch for?

elaine: We're rolling it into the community-run CI job as opt-in. The adapter templates default to fast sanity checks; full perf runs must opt into the nightly job. No regressions expected — but please report any perf deltas via the issue template.

priya: I can smoke-test HF and ONNX adapters tomorrow in eu-west-1.

ci-bot: CI pipeline kicked for release v1.0.0-interop — 3 jobs queued, 2 passed, 1 running.

ben: Can we schedule a short demo 30-min sync for next Tue? I can demo the notebook and migration steps.

elaine: @ben yes — let's do Tue 10:30 PT. I'll post invite and agenda.

marcos: Thanks! I'll file an ops note with the integration checklist.

elaine: Thanks everyone — appreciate any early adopters. If you want to help triage community issues, please react with :hand:

(prior reactions: :rocket: from marcos, :eyes: from priya)
